integrity: The accompanying complete proof and deterministic verifier identify all assumptions. Computational examples confirm algebraic identities and independently solve finite-dimensional determinant programs; numerical evidence is not a substitute for the all-parameter proof.
scientific_limitations: The result covers only centered intersections \(x_i^2+z^2\le a_i^2\) with positive radii in dimension \(m+1\), for \(m\ge2\). Arbitrary rotations/translations and noncircular cross-sections are not covered. The upper bound is a nonattained degenerate-radius limit. Historical-priority assessment is not independently certified.
title: Extremal ellipsoids and a sharp volume ratio for rectangular-section Steinmetz bodies
